## Class Test-2: date and coverage

**Thursday, 22 October 2026 · Duration: 1 hour · EE, ME and MT sections only.**

**Coverage: functions, pointers, structures and strings**, drawing on the relevant
parts of Weeks [09](weeks/w09.qmd), [10](weeks/w10.qmd) and [11](weeks/w11.qmd),
and Labs [07](labsheets/lab07.qmd), [08](labsheets/lab08.qmd) and [09](labsheets/lab09.qmd).

- **Functions:** declaration, definition, calls, scope, return values, and changing caller variables through pointer parameters.
- **Pointers:** addresses and dereferencing, pointer arithmetic, and the relationship between pointers and arrays.
- **Structures:** members, copying records, arrays of structures, and pointers to structures (`.` and `->`).
- **Strings:** character arrays, null termination, traversal and in-place processing.

Arrays (including multidimensional arrays), conditionals, branching, loops, arithmetic,
and standard input/output may be used with these topics. **File handling, dynamic
memory allocation and recursion are not included.**

**Format:** 30 marks. Each section has four questions; the best three scores count
independently: Section A (MCQ), 6 marks; Section B (code completion), 9 marks;
Section C (program/function completion), 15 marks. No negative marking.

:::

**Institute holidays that affect our slots:** Wed Aug 26 (Milad-un-Nabi), Mon Oct 19 & Tue Oct 20 (Dussehra), Mon Nov 9 (Govardhan Puja), Tue Nov 10 (Declared Holiday), Wed Nov 11 (Bhai Duj).

## Weekly Plan (Lectures)

The plan below is **tentative** and will be adjusted as the semester progresses. Slides marked *Lec n* are from [CS1100, IIT Madras](./cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/index.qmd), reused with permission — see [acknowledgements](./index.qmd#acknowledgements). Additional notes will be posted as we go.

Each week's page carries Pre-read, In-Class, and After-Class sections — and ends with **PAGAL Notes** (*Perspectives on Algorithms, Generative AI & Learning*): an informal, blog-style weekly column on how that week's material looks in the age of AI.

| [02](weeks/w02.qmd) | Aug 10, Aug 11 | *Mon:* the computer revisited — von Neumann architecture, the Toy Computer (stored programs vs calculators). *Tue:* number systems — radix-q, binary & hex, conversions; signed integers; fixed & floating point, IEEE FP32 | [Deck 04](materials/w02-deck-04-computer-revisited.html) · [Toy Computer](materials/w02-toy-computer.html) · [Under the Hood 1–3](materials/w02-under-the-hood-1-parts.html) · [Deck 03](materials/w02-deck-03-number-systems.html) · [Lec 3](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec3.pdf) |

Complements/overflow reference for CT-1. *CT-1 window opens Aug 19* | [Deck 06](materials/w03-deck-06-first-c-program.html) · [Deck 07](materials/w03-deck-07-types-operators.html) · [Deck 05](materials/w03-deck-05-complements-overflow.html) · [Lec 4](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec4.pdf) |
